text: that approach kinda sucks, if i want to have a booth seat for example i need sitting offsets it should behave in a manner that i rig a face or something. it just trying to find its own location is never going to work
resolution: Implemented the correction — rig a FACE, not a point, with multiple offsets (a booth). deriveSeatFromFaces (31738a0a1): the seat face's length yields multiple evenly-spaced occupant slots, so 'find its own location' is gone — you pick the polygon, the polygon defines the seat. Part of the full vertical (req_2030).
